qa_pairs.question: What kind of information is presented in the section labelled 'Information ordonnanceur' on the Metrix portal?
qa_pairs.answer: The 'Information ordonnanceur' section displays scheduler-related details.

qa_pairs.question: How can users access their CPU account tracking page from the scheduler information section in the Metrix portal?
qa_pairs.answer: Users can access their CPU account tracking page by clicking on their account number within the scheduler information section.
